description: This Java source file provides utility methods for constructing SQL queries, handling SQL parameter binding, and processing SQL results within the OFBiz framework. It includes functions to generate FROM and WHERE clauses, bind values to SQL statements, and retrieve typed values from ResultSets, focusing on JDBC interactions for entity management.

classes.name: SqlJdbcUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for constructing SQL clauses, binding values, and processing ResultSet data in JDBC operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: makeFromClause
methods.description: Constructs the SQL FROM clause, including JOINs, based on the entity model and data source join style.

methods.name: makeWhereStringFromFields
methods.description: Creates a portion of a WHERE clause based on provided fields and operators.

methods.name: makeWhereClause
methods.description: Builds a complete WHERE clause, combining field-based conditions with view entity conditions.

methods.name: makeViewWhereClause
methods.description: Generates the WHERE clause fragment for view entities, respecting join styles.

methods.name: makeOrderByClause
methods.description: Creates an ORDER BY clause for SQL statements based on provided ordering fields.

methods.name: filterColName
methods.description: Sanitizes column names by replacing characters with underscores.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Binds a list of ModelField values from an entity to an SQL statement via SQLProcessor.

methods.name: setValuesWhereClause
methods.description: Binds ModelField values for a WHERE clause, skipping nulls.

methods.name: setPkValues
methods.description: Binds primary key values of an entity to an SQL statement.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a typed value from a ResultSet and assigns it to a GenericEntity field.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Binds a field value from a GenericEntity to an SQL statement via SQLProcessor.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Overloaded method that binds a specific value to an SQL statement, handling different Java types.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Maps Java type names to internal integer codes representing SQL data types.

methods.name: addValueSingle
methods.description: Appends a single value placeholder or literal to SQL condition strings.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Appends a collection of values or a single value to SQL condition strings.
